Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to correctly interpret the conflicting data presented by the WebSurfer in Step 1. The search results clearly showed two different death dates: one from Britannica (March 24, 1931) and one from Wikipedia/Tate (August 13, 1896). Instead of flagging this discrepancy, prioritizing the more reliable source (Wikipedia/Tate), or attempting to resolve the conflict, the Planner incorrectly accepted the 1931 date as a potential valid finding and proceeded to search for it. This led to a cycle of redundant searches and confusion, as the 1931 date was a hallucination or error in the search snippet, while the correct date (1896) was already visible in the same results.
